result.evidence_quote: Cross-sectionally, higher Hb levels correlated with lower insulin sensitivity (r=-0.35, p = 0.005), higher resting O2 consumption (r = 0.41, p < 0.001), higher resting energy expenditure (r = 0.49, p < 0.001), higher LFC (r = 0.40, p = 0.011), and greater left ventricular wall thickness (r = 0.42, p = 0.001).
result.rationale: The study connects hemoglobin with cardiometabolic risk markers and left ventricular structure in adults with metabolic syndrome. This is relevant to cardiovascular risk and prevention, although its primary focus is metabolic physiology rather than cardiovascular disease, risk prediction, or clinical cardiovascular outcomes.
